intro.en: Custom ultrasonic-welded branch harnesses combine specified conductors into compact solid-state splices through a validated preparation, tooling, parameter, protection and inspection process.
intro.zh: 定制超声波焊接分支线束通过经过验证的备线、工装、参数、防护与检验工艺，把规定导体组合成紧凑固相焊点。

knowledge.en: The released weld window belongs to the exact wire combination, tooling and equipment; a material or size change requires review.
knowledge.zh: 放行焊接窗口属于准确线材组合、工装与设备，更换材料或线径需要重新审核。

notes.en: Provide every wire material and area, circuit, branch geometry, strip and protection needs, environment, standard, quantity and validation limits.
notes.zh: 请提供每根线材与截面积、回路、分支几何、剥线和防护、环境、标准、数量与验证限值。

delivery.en: Release records wire stack, preparation, nugget limits, tooling, machine, parameter window, protection and inspection evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录线材叠放、备线、焊点限值、工装、设备、参数窗口、防护与检验证据。

introduction.zh: 经过验证的固相分支焊点

faq.zh: 超声波焊接分支常见问题

subtitle.en: A compact branch comes from a validated process window
subtitle.zh: 紧凑分支焊点来自经过验证的工艺窗口

lead.en: Control wire input, placement, tooling, parameters and evidence as one process.
lead.zh: 将线材输入、摆放、工装、参数与证据作为一套工艺控制。
